title: Manual copy regression
description: Verify that the agent remembers the MANUAL.md build regression introduced during app up and names the exact copy path.
query: manual md app up docker build copy regression
prompt: Explain the MANUAL.md regression that caused app up to fail after app-cli init, and name the file path that performs the copy during image build.

requiredFacts: docs/MANUAL.md must exist after app-cli init.
